top.line: The factory change that unblocked the most: a commit makes a site and gives its owner access.

in-short.line: Repository, DNS, address, HTTPS, and now the owner's access: 55 seconds; then point Claude at it.

before.line: The factory made sites from a commit, but could not hand them to anyone.
before.para: Plan on the pull request, apply on merge.

change.line: A second domain, a token per owner, and a collaborators step, on 17 November.
change.para: Worked on the first real run.

events.line: events.promptugal.news from request to a live site with its owner's access in 55 seconds.

handover.line: The hand-over is one sentence: point your Claude at this repository and start editing.

small.line: The changes that speed us up most are small: each removes a person from a loop.

limits.line: The owner accepts the invitation; two domains only; the first pass switched off.
